memory.content: Prefers a short morning digest that summarizes tomorrow’s calendar and flags anything that needs prep the night before.
Uses Google Calendar for schedule awareness and Gmail for professional correspondence.
Often asked to research travel, real estate, shopping, and local errands end-to-end, then report options with a clear recommendation.
